As a consultant, he has years of experience of working with national and international government organizations such as OECD, World Bank, Mozambique Government, Portuguese Municipalities, Direção-Geral das Autarquias Locais, Ministério da Economia. Previously, he was Administrator and member of the Management Board of the Universidade do Minho (2019-2014) and Vice-President of the School of Economics and Management (2015-2017).
